title: Multi-Site health alert acknowledgement fallback
red: SiteHealthAlertAcknowledgementFallbackContractTests initially failed because the acknowledgement endpoint did not receive SiteHealthHistory or merge process-memory observations.
focusedTests: 39/39 passed across the Multi-Site health, alert, fallback, display-state, Browser, and Desktop regression set; the class-name runner reported SiteHealthAlertAcknowledgeTests as a missing helper name and executed the discovered tests successfully
implementation: Alert acknowledgement now merges bounded process-memory observations with PostgreSQL history before deciding whether the current alert is actionable. Acknowledgement writes still require PostgreSQL, and the response reports history retention state.
boundary: This module does not bypass PostgreSQL for acknowledgement writes and does not change role or CSRF enforcement. PostgreSQL-backed live outage execution, authenticated visual published-EXE smoke, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain outside this verification run.
